title: Do Life With You
public_slide_copy: When I say I want to do life with you, I mean:
Grocery lists with both our handwriting.
Buying two of everything without thinking.
Saving your chair when you're not there yet.
Slow dancing in the kitchen, just because.
Washing dishes while you dry them badly.
Wandering markets and forgetting the list.
Choosing the boring parts, because they're ours.
caption_option: The small version of forever. The one with coffee, lists, chores, saved chairs, and a kitchen that becomes a dance floor for no reason.
alt_text_summary: An illustrated A Story of Two carousel showing Aachu and Zuv turning ordinary daily rituals into romance: coffee, groceries, buying two things, saving a chair, kitchen dancing, dishes, laundry, markets, and a quiet shared home.
